title: React Page Compiler
description: Formal compiler for React page components: route-level components that compose hooks, forms, and components. Enforces typed params, loading/error/empty states, SEO metadata, and layout integration.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract page-spec.json: route, params, data dependencies, layout, auth requirement, SEO fields

pipeline.title: Scaffold
pipeline.description: Generate Page.tsx skeleton and test stub

pipeline.title: Implement
pipeline.description: Write full page: typed route params, data via hooks, loading/error/empty state rendering, layout integration, SEO metadata

pipeline.title: Test
pipeline.description: Write and run page tests: render with mocked hooks, loading state, error state, empty state, param handling

pipeline.title: Verify
pipeline.description: Cross-check page against schema, verify SEO, empty state, and layout contract

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: page-spec.json exists with: name, route, layout, auth

gates.title: Naming Valid
gates.description: Page file must export a PascalCase component ending in Page or View (e.g. UserProfilePage, DashboardView)

gates.title: Route Params Typed
gates.description: URL params (useParams, props.params) must be typed — no implicit string casting or unvalidated param access

gates.title: Data Loading State
gates.description: Page must render a loading state (skeleton, spinner, or Suspense fallback) while data is being fetched — no blank render during loading

gates.title: Error Boundary
gates.description: Page must handle the error state from its data hooks — not just throw unhandled errors to the React tree

gates.title: SEO Metadata
gates.description: Page sets document.title or uses a Head/Metadata component — every page must declare its title

gates.title: Empty State
gates.description: Page handles the case when data exists but is empty (empty list, null entity) — must render a meaningful empty state, not blank

gates.title: Schema Alignment
gates.description: If page renders entity data and schema-artifact.json exists, data field access must align with schema fields. Schema is source of truth.

gates.title: Page Contract
gates.description: Page satisfies structural contract: uses layout, no raw fetch in component body, auth guard if required, no inline styles

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled React page components

error_codes.RP002: Page component not named with Page or View suffix
error_codes.RP005: Route params accessed without type annotation
error_codes.RP006: No loading state rendered during data fetch
error_codes.RP007: Error state from data hook not handled in render
error_codes.RP010: Page missing SEO title (document.title or Head/Metadata component)
error_codes.RP011: Empty data state not handled — blank render when data is empty
error_codes.RP012: Page contract violation (raw fetch in body, missing layout, missing auth guard)
